{{Top|leg}}
The '''Pyrand River''' was a river located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doniphon]]. During the [[Kwymar Suppressions]], local rebels fighting against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] placed an outpost near there.
